newConcepts.title: Мартин · тёплый наставник
newConcepts.prompt: Create a new original ALIVE caretaker android concept, using the attached Martin sheet only as the world/material and clean presentation reference. The user asks for MAXIMALLY FRIENDLY ANTHROPOMORPHIC ROBOT EDUCATORS, clearly distinct from the cold handsome mannequin in the reference. This is a new design alternative, not a strict identity-preserving edit. The result must immediately feel warm, trustworthy, approachable and designed to look after children, while remaining CLEARLY A ROBOT with humanlike body proportions. Three-view 16:9 cinematic concept sheet: full-body three-quarter front on left, large inviting face close-up in middle, smaller matching back view on right. All views show the same coherent robot. Clean warm-grey background, softly directional light with real form and controlled shadows, no flat washed-out lighting. No children or other people in the frame. Practical knee-length soft WORK COAT with large usable pockets, relaxed straight fit and open soft collar, modest small EDEM emblem on upper back. Avoid an ankle-length ceremonial overcoat, high military collar, fashion-model pose, sharp sinister cheekbones, hollow black eyes, excessive cables, chrome armour, weaponry, uncanny damaged skin or horror. Warmth comes from the face, stance, open hands and soft materials. This is an adaptation proposal, not a claimed literal illustration of the novel. Variant A, THE WARM MENTOR: a mature male-presenting android with an apparent kindly age of about 50–60, broad softly rounded face, full cheeks, gentle lifted brows, open hazel optical eyes with warm catchlights and a small relaxed closed-mouth smile. Short salt-and-pepper manufactured hair, no beard. The facial shell is a warm matte light-beige silicone-like synthetic surface with subtle intentional panel joints beside the temples and jaw, clearly engineered ears and a visible refined neck joint; do not make it simply a real man in a coat. The robot has a comfortable moderately broad build, rounded shoulders, slightly bent elbows, welcoming open soft five-finger hands. Its off-white work coat has slightly rolled sleeves over a soft sand-coloured inner layer; hands have tactile warm-rubber coverings, mechanical wrist rings remain clear. Humanlike but unmistakably manufactured, with the calm patience of an excellent nursery educator. Restrained design details, premium realistic materials. Small caption «Мартин · тёплый наставник». No watermark.

expression_edit_prompt: Precise expression-only edit of this fictional caretaker android concept sheet. Preserve the EXACT face identity, apparent age, hair, skin/synthetic material, engineered seams, eye colour and shape, lighting, three-view layout, body, clothing, EDEM emblem, caption and open welcoming hand gestures. This character's mouth cannot smile in the novel. Change the expression consistently in the central face close-up and left full-body view: a relaxed STILL NEUTRAL CLOSED MOUTH, corners neither raised nor drooping, no smile crease or lifted cheeks. Keep the character maximally kind and approachable through the SAME warm attentive eye contact, relaxed brow, slight listening head inclination, soft rounded face shapes and welcoming posture. He must not look angry, stern, sad or emotionally vacant. The difference should be subtle but clear: calm benevolent attention without smiling. Do not alter anything else or whiten the face. 16:9, same photoreal rendering and typography.
